Dropping channel broadens that caveat to other received MIDI message classes without evidence.

Preserve the real-time track/Push Note-versus-Session caveat. Update only the affected canonical/catalog/source_claim and necessary revised snapshots/seal; keep API/message/timing oracles null and do not invent behavior for other message classes.
